what: Deep-network Laplacian per call on PyTorch with CUDA: omnibias planned default (forward: differentiate none; value-and-gradient: differentiate params) against jet_collapsed, nested forward mode and torch.func Hessian trace, 40 cells of the per-call grid
hardware: one exclusive NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB per round, PyTorch 2.x eager with CUDA-graph replay for the device endpoint, one fresh process per round, 3 rounds per precision
protocol: f64: 3/f32h: 3/f32t: 3 fresh-process rounds of the 40-cell per-call grid; the omnibias program and every baseline are timed in the same process of a round (host-timed call: median of repeated blocks; device: mean of 32 back-to-back calls with one synchronisation, a CUDA-graph replay on PyTorch); ratio = baseline time / omnibias time, median over rounds, 95 % hierarchical bootstrap interval over rounds
